title: Bạn có thể giúp tôi liên hệ với hãng hàng không của tôi không?
englishTitle: Can you help me contact my airline?
pronunciation: Ban co the giup toi lien he voi hang hang khong cua toi khong
summary: For asking a desk, hotel, or helpful local to help reach your airline.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Use it when a flight, bag, check-in, cancellation, or connection problem needs the airline, not just local staff.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Show the booking, flight number, boarding pass, or airline app before adding the story.

phrases.vietnamese: Bạn có thể giúp tôi liên hệ với hãng hàng không của tôi không?
phrases.english: Can you help me contact my airline?
phrases.pronunciation: Ban co the giup toi lien he voi hang hang khong cua toi khong

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Bạn có thể means can you; giúp tôi liên hệ means help me contact; hãng hàng không của tôi means my airline.

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: Contact the driver, contact the hotel, and emergency contact phrases cover nearby help calls.

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Good at airport information desks, hotel reception, tour counters, and help desks with a phone nearby.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Lead with the airline name and flight number. That helps the helper skip straight to the right contact path.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Lost luggage, baggage tag, driver, information desk, and departure hall phrases cover common airport follow-ups.
